articles.title: Kintara’s Halloween event adds Haunted Chests and rare Zombie Masks to its Solana MMO
articles.description: In Brief:Kintara (official site) has switched on a Halloween event in its Solana browser MMO, bringing Haunted Chests, limited cosmetics and rare Zombie Mask drops. The release also includes event mounts, pets and furniture, and the team says all of it is live now. It follows two October announcements: the Sunken Isles, Kintara's first open-water biome, and the game's first ranged weapon. Halloween content has arrived in Kintara, with Haunted Chests, limited cosmetics and rare Zombie Mask drops now in the game. The team announced the event on X through its @PlayKintara account: "Halloween has taken over Kintara." Halloween has taken over Kintara Haunted Chests, limited cosmetics, rare Zombie Mask drops, event mounts, pets, furniture and more are now live. Trick or treat?@KintaraView on X ↗ The release also adds event mounts, pets and furniture. According to the post, the content and "more" are "now live." The post gave no end date and no Zombie Mask drop rate, and it didn't explain how Haunted Chests get opened. Mounts and furnitureSeveral of the seasonal items plug into systems players already use. The furniture suits the Apartments introduced in version 3.6, an update that also brought a multi-page banking system and a Merchant Cycle. Mounts matter in Kintara's economy. Once the Stablemaster Gilding feature went live, players burned more than 3,829 mounts over two days, which reduced total mount supply. The team hasn't confirmed whether the Halloween mounts can be gilded or traded on the Marketplace. A busy OctoberKintara has now made three content announcements this month, and the Halloween event is the latest. The first came on Oct. 7, when the team revealed that the Sunken Isles are on the way. Players will sail east from The Shores to reach the game's first open-water biome, which contains three explorable isles, coral reefs, shipwrecks and a deep-sea trench. The zone's ultra-rare drops include the Coral Crown, a Trident and a Kraken mount. On Oct. 8, a day later, Kintara introduced its first ranged weapon. Sahriel the Bowbinder set up shop in the Dunes with a Bow priced at 50 gold and 20 Arrows for 1 gold. Bows reach up to four tiles and have a 1-in-3 chance to land a 40-damage hit, on players and mobs alike. BackgroundKintara went live on May 22, 2026. It's an isometric MMO played in the browser, with nothing to download. Players gather, craft, quest and fight in PvE and PvP, and each player's Solana wallet doubles as their account. Two currencies run the game. Gold handles everyday activity, while $KINS is the onchain token. Players can earn $KINS by selling gold on the open Marketplace, winning PvP wagers in the Wilderness or pulling rare fishing drops. Marketplace sellers keep 95% of every sale. The other 5% is a fee that once went entirely to the treasury. It's now split, with 2.5% burned and 2.5% going to the treasury. In August, Kintara arrived on Solana Mobile. The game's official guide names "Merchants and events" as one of the ways gold enters its economy. The Halloween post closed with a two-word question for players: "Trick or treat?"

Lesaka Webcast and Conference Call to Review First Quarter 2027 Results
articles.description: JOHANNESBURG, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lesaka Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: LSAK, JSE: LSK) ("Lesaka") today announced it will release first quarter 2027 results after the U.S. market close on November 4, 2026. Lesaka management will host a presentation webcast and conference call on November 5, 2026, at 8:00am EST (3:00pm SAST), followed by a live question and answer session for analysts and investors. Webcast Registration Link to access the results webcast: https://www.corpcam.com/Lesaka05112026 Participants using the webcast will be able to submit questions during the live Question and Answer session. Conference call dial-in via Chorus Call: Link to register: https://services.choruscall.it/DiamondPassRegistration/register?confirmationNumber=2913271&linkSecurityString=8f2e4442f Dial in details and individual pin to be provided on registration. Participants using the conference call dial-in will be able to ask their questions during the live Question and Answer session. Following the presentation, an archived version of the webcast will be provided on Lesaka’s Investor Relations website. About Lesaka Technologies, Inc. (www.lesaka.tech) Lesaka operates a South African fintech company driven by a purpose to provide financial services, software and other business services to Southern Africa's underserviced consumers and merchants. We offer an integrated and holistic multiproduct platform that provides transactional accounts, lending, insurance, merchant acquiring, cash management, software and Alternative Digital Products ("ADP"). We provide targeted solutions and integrations to facilitate payments between consumers, merchants, and enterprises. By providing a full-service fintech platform in our connected ecosystem, we facilitate the digitization of commerce in our markets. Lesaka has a primary listing on NASDAQ (NASDAQ: LSAK) and a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE: LSK). Visit www.lesaka.tech for additional information about Lesaka. Investor Relations Contacts: Idris Dungarwalla Email: idris.dungarwalla@lesakatech.com Media Relations Contact: Ian Harrison Email: Ian@thenielsennetwork.com
